what: Within-family pairs of newer and older releases, from names, sizes and dates only, written before any w is read by scripts/release_dates.py
request: release dates and newest-model reversal shares
rule: Within a family (the panel manifest's family; the ladder's for the extension), each checkpoint is paired with the most recent checkpoint of the same family released strictly earlier (release dates of manifests/panel_release_dates.json) and of similar size. Similar size: the same architecture kind (dense, or mixture of experts as the name's A<n>B tag or the recorded size says) and total parameters within a factor of 1.5 (larger over smaller); for mixtures of experts the active parameters also within that factor. A tie in date goes to the nearer total size, then to the key in alphabetical order. Each checkpoint is the newer side of at most one pair; a checkpoint can be the older side of several. Checkpoints released on the same date are not paired. Sizes: params_b of manifests/d2_panel_extension.json (panel), the sizes block of results/ladder/analysis/ladder.json (extension); a checkpoint without a recorded size (Qwen4-Max) enters no pair. Counted on a benchmark: the pairs whose two checkpoints both have w there; the newer is higher when its w exceeds the older's by more than 1e-9, a tie when the two are within 1e-9.
rule_alt: Within a family (the panel manifest's family; the ladder's for the extension), each checkpoint is paired with the most recent checkpoint of the same family released strictly earlier (release dates of manifests/panel_release_dates.json) and of similar size. Similar size: the same architecture kind (dense, or mixture of experts as the name's A<n>B tag or the recorded size says) and total parameters within a factor of 2.0 (larger over smaller); for mixtures of experts the active parameters also within that factor. A tie in date goes to the nearer total size, then to the key in alphabetical order. Each checkpoint is the newer side of at most one pair; a checkpoint can be the older side of several. Checkpoints released on the same date are not paired. Sizes: params_b of manifests/d2_panel_extension.json (panel), the sizes block of results/ladder/analysis/ladder.json (extension); a checkpoint without a recorded size (Qwen4-Max) enters no pair. Counted on a benchmark: the pairs whose two checkpoints both have w there; the newer is higher when its w exceeds the older's by more than 1e-9, a tie when the two are within 1e-9. (A wider size band, written with the main rule and reported in the summary only.)
